title: Club Innovation – Learn how to assess the digital accessibility of your platforms yourself
excerpt: The Chambre des Métiers, in collaboration with the Enterprise Europe Network and Luxinnovation, is organizing a special session of the Innovation Club, during which testing experts from Q-Leap will focus on the practical implementation of the law on accessibility of products and services.
